newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American Homestar estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American Homestar estimates.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial Inc said Wednesday it raised its earnings estimate for American Homestar Corp in fiscal 1997 to $1.28 a share from $1.24 and its fiscal 1998 estimate to $1.57 from $1.54.
-- Mesirow said the move follows American Homestar's strong results in the third quarter ended February 28, in which earnings totaled $0.28 a share, higher than Mesirow's estimate of $0.25.
-- American Homestar recorded its 11th consecutive quarter of record revenues and earnings, and Mesirow expects the robust trends to continue in the fourth quarter and in 1998.
-- American Homestar operates eight manufacturing plants, 49 company-owned retail centers and serves more than 300 independent retail locations in 24 states.
-- Its shares were up 1/4 Wednesday at 17-3/4.
